decisions.reason: The source's investment-case conclusion and projection status are already fully represented by the candidate's existing message-24 MODIFY.
The source reinforces the overall availability-payment justification but does not change the capex estimate, capex basis, or shared-cost treatment; capex is already marked provisional.
The source does not change the confirmed debt-equity split, debt cost, mezzanine treatment, or financing structure.
The conclusion that user fees alone are insufficient does not modify the selected operating-cost range or its source basis.
The source does not change the authoritative Business Case site list or the eight-site network scope.
The request for robust financial data supports the investment narrative but does not establish a new data-review, formula-checking, or model-quality rule.
Calling the figures projections does not change the existing requirement to annotate assumptions or the prescribed reference basis.
The source changes the substantive investment-case message, not the model's presentation-quality or auditability requirements.
